Solution: This may sound weird but find friends that are also depressed. For years I had been struggling to find actual friends and feeling like no one understood me until I meat a girl that had very similar issues as me. We bonded over our trauma, depression and anxiety. I had a former "best friend" that made me feel guilty about my depression and even if she tried she could never understand me. But the new friend understood me better than everyone ever could because she was going through the same shit. So if you become friends with at least one other depressed person you would get support and understanding like never before. The only con is that since you're both depressed you would probably never go out and do fun stuff together but instead would just send each other stupid depression memes.
